Water Bubble.short_desc: This Pokemon's Water power is 2x; it can't be burned; Fire power against it is halved.

Water Compaction.short_desc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.

Water Veil.short_desc: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

Weak Armor.short_desc: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, Defense is lowered by 1, Speed is raised by 2.

Well-Baked Body.short_desc: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages if hit by a Fire move; Fire immunity.

White Smoke.short_desc: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

Wimp Out.short_desc: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.

Wind Power.short_desc: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins.

Wind Rider.short_desc: Attack raised by 1 if hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins. Wind move immunity.

Wonder Guard.short_desc: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.

Wonder Skin.short_desc: Status moves with accuracy checks are 50% accurate when used on this Pokemon.

Zen Mode.short_desc: If Darmanitan, at end of turn changes Mode to Standard if > 1/2 max HP, else Zen.

Zero to Hero.short_desc: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
